title: Alternative local cam slopes and loaded drum
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of W (vertical) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. One positive angular increment changes the sampled radii by 2 and 2 mm. The two radii must sum to the fixed center distance. A positive, B negative. The taut line follows the left tangent of drum B; CW there is up. B negative, W negative. The requested motion is down (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: B
options.explanation: W must be down. The taut line follows the left tangent of drum B; CW there is up. B negative, W negative..
